response.overview: Thirty-eight-year-old Max Petrisino is just 121 days away from leaving his hometown, his dead-end dish washing job, and his ailing father behind to start fresh out west. After a lifetime of false starts, his escape plan feels like the only thing keeping him going. But then Charlie Hawkins enters and hits the pause button on his countdown clock. As Max grapples with his feelings for Charlie and the weight of the life he's trying to abandon, he's faced with a choice: pack his bags to leave or unpack his baggage to stay.
response.title: It's Always Almost Over
